notes.title: Update 01
notes.content:
[h1]Update 01[/h1]
[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
  - Duplicate day 7 dialogues
  - Pause Menu not working after playing arcade mode
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
  - Arcade mode is more challenging and works with all game mechanics.
  - Added "Hard mode" (with Hard mode off, "times" on all levels are doubled).
